title: GLOVA: Global and Local Variation-Aware Analog Circuit Design with Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning
problem: Analog/mixed-signal circuit design faces significant performance degradation from process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations and manufacturing mismatches, requiring iterative manual revisions and extensive simulations to achieve commercial-grade reliability.
motivation: Automation of variation-aware analog design is critical to reduce time-to-market, but existing approaches do not adequately address real-world wafer-level mismatches and yield requirements.
method: GLOVA uses risk-sensitive reinforcement learning with ensemble-based critic to optimize analog circuit sizing while accounting for PVT variations and random mismatches. The framework employs mu-sigma evaluation and simulation reordering to reduce verification costs, supporting corner simulation and Monte Carlo methods for industrial-level validation.
key_novelty: Integration of risk-sensitive RL with ensemble critics for robust analog circuit sizing under diverse PVT variations and manufacturing mismatches.
contributions: Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning framework for variation-aware analog sizing
Mu-sigma evaluation method reducing simulation costs for failed designs
80.5x improvement in sample efficiency and 76x reduction in time vs. prior work
baselines: Previous state-of-the-art variation-aware analog sizing frameworks
primary_theme: RL-based automation for robust analog circuit design under PVT variation
